early_close_or_void_clauses: Expiration moved earlier on departure event (Rule 7.2)

Each deadline evaluated independently; multiple can resolve Yes
title_vs_rules_divergences: Title 'leave as CEO' vs rules: announcing a FUTURE departure alone does not qualify - CEO must actually have left; a pre-announced transition effective later does not trigger until effective
